Glover stated that he and the other members of the Sweet Georgia Sound were looking forward to visiting Cleveland this weekend.
"This is such a beautiful region," Glover said. "I always love coming to an area that is so well rounded."
"This is such an enjoyable type of music," Glover said. "We want to make people enjoy themselves when they walk in and come out of the venue with a smile. We think they will have fun."
He said that the Sweet Georgia Sound will perform songs from an orchestra similar to the one Frank Sinatra would sing with, and perhaps even include some of Greg's songs as well.
"We’re going to play a lot of classics and jazz standards, but laugh a lot in between...so come out and join us."
